value.rationale: The star is a canonical many-leaf/single-hub degree-heterogeneous interaction. Exact persistence of non-Gaussian leaf-density fluctuations at every fixed positive noise rate is a substantive mean-field failure, quantified by a nontrivial beta law, endogenous hub conditional state, and exact all-finite-n stationary variance. This is a natural stationary kinetic observable and could benchmark heterogeneous noisy-voter approximations.
